title: Cartwise+ Membership Annual Term Early End After a Switch from Monthly
content:
When a Cartwise+ Membership member ends early an annual term that a plan switch from a monthly plan opened, the charge that opened the term is refunded under this rule whenever the early end is asked for, however long ago that charge was captured and whether or not a member benefit was used since. An annual term opened by a first-period or renewal charge is not ended early under this rule.

## What the rule governs

| Item | Position |
|---|---|
| Terms covered | an annual term of a Cartwise+ Membership that a plan switch from a monthly plan opened |
| Terms not covered | an annual term opened by a first-period or renewal charge |
| When it can be asked for | at any time; the age of the opening charge and any benefit use since do not matter |
| What is refunded | the charge that opened the term, priced as a term-opening refund and never as a refund of the whole charge |
| Where the money goes | the original payment method |
| Whose act it is | the member's own confirmation of the early end |

## Business effect

The refund entry is booked on the membership against the charge that opened the term, dated the day it is confirmed, and returned to the original payment method; the membership's net fees paid go down by that amount. The membership's plan, status and dates are not changed by this action.

## Invocation: `confirm_annual_term_early_end_0b7355fe`

This is a customer-side action. The agent unlocks `confirm_annual_term_early_end_0b7355fe` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it to confirm the early end. One call books one refund entry of the prorated-annual kind on the membership, pointing at the opening charge, for the amount confirmed.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the reference number of the member's own Cartwise+ membership, as the agent read it from the membership lookup and told the member | identifier |
| `source_event_id` | the reference number of the fee charge that opened the annual term being ended, as the agent read it from the membership's entries and told the member | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the amount returned to the member on that charge | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places; more digits are rounded to the nearest cent |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a receipt with `refund_id` (the new refund entry's reference number, which the member can quote), `membership_id`, `source_event_id` (the charge refunded), `refund_type` (always `prorated_annual`), `amount_usd` (as booked, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` of `refund_booked`, meaning the refund entry now stands on the membership. The tool defines no error return.

## Points of judgement

- **Does a long gap since the opening charge bar the refund?** No; it is refunded whenever the early end is asked for.
- **Does benefit use since the charge bar it?** No.
- **Is an annual term that began with a renewal charge covered?** No; only a term a plan switch from a monthly plan opened.
